title: Customer email intake — sanitized aggregate

queries.query: -in:spam -in:trash -in:sent -in:drafts -{starnet "Star Net" starnetos} {subject:bug subject:troubleshooting subject:startup subject:credits subject:agents subject:station subject:workflow subject:splitter}

limits: Query-complete, not proof of mailbox-wide completeness: generic/no-brand mail outside these phrases may be missed.
All returned relevant thread bodies read including sent replies; attachments not exhaustively reviewed.
One screenshot attachment returned no extracted image or text. Attachment-only reports remain unresolved.
Unsupported security ZIP not opened; reserved integration thread skipped.
Whop/GitHub cross-source identity correlation limited to explicit email references; parent owns direct source intake.
No live reproduction, installer test, account ledger access or recovery action performed.

meaning: Reported symptoms and source associations, not independently reproduced defects or release acceptance. A source candidate listed here does not imply the affected installer includes it or the customer recovered.
